alex: Heads-up — prod-3 longchat workload shows steady memory growth over ~48h (streaming toolloops). Suspect KV cache reuse regression after recent kernel-selection tweak. Posting quick perf snapshot.
maya: Ugh, saw something like this in staging last week, thanks for surfacing. what exact kernel change?
alex: Commit id abc1234 changed kernel selector to prefer fused-attn-2 for 4k+ sequences. We rolled it 2 days ago to prod-3.
samir: Can you paste the profiler output? also curious about eviction counts and pagewalk rates.
alex: Here — low-res sampling (top lines):
```
heap: 78GB -> 126GB over 48h
kv-cache-resident-pages: 1.8M -> 3.2M
eviction_ops/sec: 12 -> 3
pagewalks/sec: 210 -> 890
hot_reuse_hits: 62% -> 29%
lock-contention: 0.4% -> 5.7%
```
alex: Notably eviction rate dropped while resident pages increased — looks like something prevented timely evictions and reuse hit rate collapsed.
jinwoo: That pagewalk jump is telling. Could be fragmentation causing more pagechains per lookup. Any change in slab sizing or allocator flags with that kernel path?
maya: We also saw a slight change in continuous batching heuristics in the same deploy (max_batch_ms bumped). Could be interaction.
samir: Ran a quick query on metrics: `sum(evictions_total) by instance` for prod-3 shows flatlined evictions after the deploy window. pointing to eviction logic being bypassed
alex: I reproduced in a small repro on staging with longtoolloop profile. When forcing old kernel selector (rollback abc1234) the growth stops and reuse hits recover to ~60% in 6 hours.
ops-bot: deploy-notice: rollback started for service inference/prod-3 by jinwoo at 2026-03-15T12:06Z
maya: Nice repro, any more low-level traces? kvcache debug logs around evict decision would help.
alex: Attached snippet of kvcache decision log (filtered):
```
[2026-03-15T11:22:01Z] evict_decide: candidate=0.23 threshold=0.25 -> skip
[2026-03-15T11:22:02Z] reclaim_scan: scanned=1200 reclaimed=0
[2026-03-15T11:22:03Z] reuse_probe: hot_bucket_probe=8 misses=7
[2026-03-15T11:22:05Z] put_pagechain: append: chain_len=3
[2026-03-15T11:22:06Z] pagewalk: traversed=14
```
alex: Looks like thresholds are slightly higher after kernel tweak and the scan budget is lower, so we skip evict more often. Also chain lengths increasing — fragmentation.
jinwoo: Hypothesis: fused-attn-2 kernel allocates larger ephemeral buffers and increases lock hold time on the KV allocator, reducing reclaim throughput. The selector change made more requests go that codepath so reclaim lags.
samir: Agreed. Two-pronged fix: (1) lower eviction threshold and raise reclaim_scan_budget for now; (2) add a test in perf-suite that stresses long streaming sessions with the new kernel to catch future regressions.
maya: I can push a hotfix config to lower thresholds and monitor. Any regressions risk with that? Temporary higher eviction aggressiveness could increase tail latency.
alex: We'll monitor latencies — but memory growth is critical. Also schedule a perf regression test in CI and add a trace to kvcache to measure chain length histogram.
ops-bot: rolling-update: config-inference/prod-3 eviction_threshold=0.22 reclaim_budget=1500 by maya at 2026-03-15T12:18Z
maya: After change, first 30m looks encouraging: eviction_ops/sec climbed from 3->18 and resident pages flattened. Will watch for 6h.
jinwoo: Follow-up: add a mitigation flag to force older kernel selector per deployment for canary gating until perf-suite passes.
samir: I'll own the perf-suite job and add a test case with 12h streaming chat with toolloops, check pagewalks, reuse hits, and chain length histograms.
alex: Thanks all — kept notes in the incident doc. If we see recurrence we'll escalate to infra allocator owners. :thumbsup
